[IRET.27.5] Each RHS action verb invokes the dispatcher operation below
directly — there is no intervening interpretation step — with the operands
named. Every verb but `emit` reaches the terminal as a builtin op on a
`CallExpr` ([RDSC.4a.9.3]); `emit` is an action kind of its own,
`ACTION_ASSERT` or `ACTION_LOGICAL_ASSERT` ([RDSC.4a.8]).

| Verb | `BuiltinFn` op | Dispatcher operation | Operands |
|---|---|---|---|
| `emit` | none: `ACTION_ASSERT` / `ACTION_LOGICAL_ASSERT` | assert into working memory | schema, slots, logical flag, token |
| `publish` | `FN_PUBLISH` | publish | schema, slots |
| `call` | `FN_CALL` | issue a call | service, correlation, typed arguments ([RLOW.7.3.1]), cooldown_ns |
| `cache` | `FN_CACHE_SET` | cache set | key, value_json, ttl_ns |
| `cache_delete` | `FN_CACHE_DELETE` | cache delete | key |
| `log` | `FN_LOG` | log | level, rule_name, message |

A logical `emit` additionally passes the firing activation token as the TMS
justifier ([IRET.12]); the engine retracts the emitted fact when the justifying
activation ends.
